summary.content:
Today's selection covers 95 articles from 9 trusted sources, including 59 on Artificial Intelligence and 15 on Fraud/Cybersecurity.

• **AI Spotlight**: Another OpenAI Executive, Denise Dresser, Departs the A.I. Start-Up

• **Security Alert**: Ukraine shuts down 94 fraudulent call centers, seize millions in cash
• **Threat Landscape**: Today's coverage highlights ransomware, data breaches, scams
• **Source Diversity**: Articles sourced from NY Times Tech, BleepingComputer, BBC Technology, The Verge, TechCrunch and others
• **Fresh Content**: 49 articles published in the last 24 hours
